name: forget
description: Forget: a standalone, 100% local Windows app to clean up your own history (Discord, X, Reddit, TikTok reposts) and scan data brokers. Offline by default, no telemetry.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix desktop install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:discord && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:limiter && npm run test:import && npm run test:social && npm run test:v5 && npm run test:v43 && npm run test:security
